title: Jets OC Frank Reich on Breece Hall: My mindset is if he's healthy, just play ball

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jets OC Frank Reich on Breece Hall: My mindset is if he's healthy, just play ball
sources.description: Jets running back Breece Hall was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's practice, which puts him on track to play against the Titans in Week 1 after missing a chunk of time this summer with a groin injury.
